overview_description.description: Sandbox Banking develops a banking platform that connects new fintech software to existing systems. The company's mission is to democratize digital transformation in the financial industry through secure, scalable integration technology embedded with deep industry intelligence. It helps financial services organizations innovate faster by making it easy to connect applications and data.
